QuestInfo.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Second Worry
QuestInfo.0: I hear #p203# in #m10001000# has a new concern...
QuestInfo.1: I saw #p203# again in #m10001000#; she's still preparing for the village carnival. She said that this time she needs food for the carnival and asked me to collect #b10 #t4000008#s#k, #b30 #t4000012#s#k, and #b#t4031005##k. To get the Special Sauce, I think I'll have to go find #p300# in #m10002010#.
QuestInfo.2: I met up with #b#p300##k in #m10002010# to get her #b#t4031005##k, but she apparently doesn't want to give it to me for free...

0.0: Hey, you're back! I'm putting the materials you got me last time to good use. The town is almost ready for the carnival that's coming up really soon. Unfortunately, there's another problem at hand. Do you want to hear me out?

yes.0: I can't thank you enough for saying yes. Decorating the town for the carnival is important, but it's much more important to offer the tourists some food, you know? The problem is that we've run out of the ingredients for the big feast.
yes.1: Can you bring me #b10 #t4000008#s#k, #b30 #t4000012#s#k, and #b1 of #t4031005##k? You can get #b#t4031005##k from #b#p300##k, who should be in #m10002010#. Thank you, and good luck!

no.0: I thought you were going to help. If you feel like changing your mind, though, then please come see me. I need as much help as I can get!

npc.0: I need lots of ingredients for the big feast at the carnival. Can you get me #b10 #t4000008#s#k, #b30 #t4000012#s#k, and #b1 of #t4031005##k? You can get #t4031005# from #b#p300##k, who should be in #m10002010#. Thank you, and good luck!
